title: Dataq Twinverse — Overview
meta_description: Sense, simulate, act — the operations stack for physical assets.

blocks.x: Sense, simulate, act — the operations stack for physical assets. Dataq Twinverse is the platform layer behind it — deployed under NDA, documented for the audit.

Dataq Twinverse bridges sensor fabric to decisions: governed telemetry (OPC UA/Sparkplug) from retrofit-friendly devices, physics+data digital twins with validated models, edge inference fleets with OTA, predictive maintenance wired into CMMS work orders, and the scenario engines planners actually use. Twinverse is built for brownfield reality: non-invasive mounting, protocol translation from fieldbuses, offline-first edge patterns, and calibration discipline. Twins ship with the decisions they must improve and the baseline they must beat — a decision instrument, not a 3D screenshot.

blocks.x: Twinverse runs IEC 62443-aligned segmentation for industrial estates, hardware roots of trust and signed boot on edge fleets, and privacy governance (face blurring, retention) for camera systems. Telemetry carries contracts — units, timestamps and lineage are trustworthy by construction.

Dataq Twinverse runs under NDA in Manufacturing & Industrial, Energy & Utilities, Logistics & Supply Chain, Retail & Consumer Goods, Agriculture & Food Systems. Deployments stay private; the architecture and control packs are the part we can show.
Connects to: OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B, LoRaWAN/NB-IoT, KubeEdge/K3s, CMMS/MES adapters. Adapters are versioned and contract-tested, so upgrades stop being incidents.
The next step is small and real: one working session on Dataq Twinverse, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
